intro: Choose your version, manage mods and continue your adventure.
helpText: Download a version from Versions. Match mods to your game version. Check your player name and memory before launching.
settingsIntro: Manage your player, language and performance preferences in one place.
ramHelp: Leave at least 2 GB free for Windows and other applications.
invalid: Enter a valid player name and 1–32 GB of memory.
privacyText: Automatic telemetry and remote administration have been removed. Launcher updates come only from the official GitHub repository and package integrity is verified.
updateDisabled: Unsigned automatic updates are disabled. Use the GitHub release page.
portableOnly: This preview runs as a portable application. Installation and uninstallation are disabled.
serverAuthPreserved: Server authentication preserved; server.properties was not changed.
Tünel açmak sunucu kimlik doğrulamasını: Opening a tunnel does not change server authentication. The server administrator controls security settings.
mcsIntro: Create your server, keep your tools current and manage everything with Auto-MCS.
mcsAutomatic: Automatically update Auto-MCS when the launcher opens
mcsSafeUpdate: Updates come from the official repository and are verified with SHA-256. Updates wait while Auto-MCS is running; servers and settings are preserved.
mcsCreateHelp: Set up Vanilla, Paper, Fabric and other supported server types inside Auto-MCS.
mcsManageHelp: Access the console, manage add-ons and monitor your servers.
mcsBackupHelp: Create a server backup inside Auto-MCS before major changes.
mcsIdle: Use the update button to check the latest release.
mcsCurrent: Auto-MCS is up to date; file integrity verified.
mcsAvailable: A newer release or unverified installation was found. Use the update button to install the latest version.
mcsNotInstalled: Auto-MCS is not installed. Select Install and launch.
mcsRunning: Auto-MCS is running. Close it before updating.
mcsError: Update could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
mcsStarted: Auto-MCS started. Manage your servers inside the application.
mcsAlreadyRunning: Auto-MCS is already running. Continue in its open window.
luIdle: The latest stable release is checked at startup and every 30 minutes.
luAvailable: A new launcher release is available. Use the update button.
luDeferred: Update deferred until the current operation finishes.
luReady: Update ready. The launcher will restart.
luError: Launcher update failed. The current version is preserved; you can retry.
luManual: This installation is missing the update helper. Install the new portable package once manually.
forgeUnsupported: Forge is unavailable for this Minecraft version.
forgeJava: Java is required for Forge installation. Install Java in Settings.
forgeInvalid: Invalid Forge package or launch arguments.
forgeFailed: Forge installation failed. Check the log.
forgeComplete: Forge is installed and ready to select.
themeHelp: Choose a color; menus, cards and buttons adapt instantly. Your preference is saved automatically.
barHelp: Choose the shortcuts to display. The active page uses your theme color and preferences save automatically. Turn all off to hide the bar.
windowStyleHelp: Choose a look; minimize, maximize and close controls change immediately. Windows uses the standard system title bar.
modToggleHelp: Enable or disable mods without deleting them. Changes apply on the next game start; check dependent mods together.
modToggleConflict: A file with this name already exists. Nothing was overwritten.
modSyncFailed: Mod transfer failed. Files were preserved. Close Minecraft and check for conflicting filenames before trying again.
modDownloadInvalid: Mod verification failed. Check the filename, download size and SHA-512 hash. Existing files were preserved.
cloudHelp: Your profile, skin and settings sync to your account. Game files stay local.
cloudFailed: Cloud operation failed. Check your connection and account details.
cloudAuthFailed: Sign-in failed. Check your account details.
cloudSignInNeeded: Sign in to use cloud sync.
cloudSkinInvalid: Skin must be a 64×32 or 64×64 PNG (up to 64 KB).
